title: Backflow: component-decisions.json (spec 1.9, shape defined by T1)
description: Owner decisions saved by the review report and applied by `componentize.mjs --decisions`. The spec only names the verbs (accept / reject / rename / merge / split / treat as variant of); this schema fixes the shape. A decision targets a cluster by `id` (stable library id, preferred) or `sig` (S digest of the cluster leader). Effects on the next run: reject -> exclude; rename -> nameSource 'owner' (conf 100); accept -> conf 100 / band auto; merge -> merge `id` into `into`; split -> re-cluster by the named field; variant-of -> make `id` a variant set member of `into`.

exclude.description: extra path globs, same syntax as ds.config.json exclude

by.description: split: the field that separates the new clusters

props.description: variant-of: variant property values for the member, e.g. { Type: 'Ghost' }
